name: Splendid Strands Hair Salon

headline: Artistry for curly, natural and textured hair
subheadline: A one-stylist private suite by Brigette in Fort Walton Beach. 5.0 stars from 188 Google reviews.
intro: Brigette is the owner and sole stylist behind Splendid Strands, in a private salon suite on Holmes Blvd. Every new client starts with a thorough consultation so hair goals and expectations line up, and clients praise her professionalism, artistry and deep knowledge of hair health.
